fields.name: CCBUF
fields.text: Buffer for channel x's compare value. Copied into CCx on an UPDATE condition (CTRLBSET.CMD=0x3), the software update command included, provided its valid flag reads 1 and double buffering is on (CTRLBCLR.LUPD=1).

fields.name: CPTENx
fields.text: Picks capture (1) or compare (0) for channel x; enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

fields.name: DMAOS
fields.text: With 1, one DMA trigger is made on the TCC cycle after a TCC_CTRLBSET_CMD_DMAOS command; with 0, a DMA trigger is made every TCC cycle. Enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

fields.name: MSYNC
fields.text: Set it to make this TCC's counting follow its Host TCC (Client instances only); enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

fields.name: ALOCK
fields.text: Auto lock: whether overflow/underflow and re-trigger events set CTRLB.LUPD; enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

values.text: CTRLB.LUPD is left alone by overflow/underflow and re-trigger events.
Each overflow/underflow or re-trigger event sets CTRLB.LUPD to 1.

fields.name: PRESCYNC
fields.text: Re-trigger behaviour: the counter is reloaded or cleared at the following GCLK_TCC0 edge or at the following prescaler output edge, optionally with the prescaler reset too. Enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

values.name: GCLK
values.text: Counter reloaded or cleared on the next GCLK.

values.name: PRESC
values.text: Counter reloaded or cleared on the next prescaled clock.

values.name: RESYNC
values.text: Counter reloaded or cleared on the next GCLK; prescaler counter reset.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Keeps the TCC running in Standby mode; enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

fields.name: PRESCALER
fields.text: Division factor of the counter clock; enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

fields.name: RESOLUTION
fields.text: Turns on dithering to raise the TCC resolution; enable-protected, not write-synchronized.

values.name: DITH4
values.text: Dither over 16 PWM frames; pattern held in PER[3:0] and CCx[3:0].

values.name: DITH5
values.text: Dither over 32 PWM frames; pattern held in PER[4:0] and CCx[4:0].

values.name: DITH6
values.text: Dither over 64 PWM frames; pattern held in PER[5:0] and CCx[5:0].

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the TCC on or off. The written value reads back at once and SYNCBUSY.ENABLE is set until the change takes effect, then cleared; poll SYNCBUSY.ENABLE to know it is done. Not enable-protected; write-synchronized.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 returns every TCC register except DBGCTRL to its reset value and disables the TCC; any other write in the same access is dropped. Writing 0 does nothing. CTRLA.SWRST and SYNCBUSY.SWRST clear once the reset has finished. Not enable-protected; write-synchronized.

registers.name: CTRLBCLR

notes: Clears CTRLB bits without a read-modify-write; the change also shows in CTRLBSET.

fields.name: CMD
fields.text: Software re-trigger and stop commands, run on the next prescaled GCLK_TCC cycle; reads 0 once executed. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1s clears a pending command.

values.name: UPDATE
values.text: Forced update of the double-buffered registers.

fields.name: IDXCMD
fields.text: Forces cycle A or B in RAMP2 and RAMP2A; on the update condition the command runs, STATUS.IDX changes and IDXCMD clears. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1s clears a pending command.

values.name: DISABLE
values.text: Off: IDX alternates between cycles A and B.

values.name: SET
values.text: Set IDX: next cycle is cycle B.

values.name: CLEAR

values.name: HOLD

fields.name: ONESHOT
fields.text: One-shot mode, in which the TCC stops at the next overflow/underflow or stop command. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1 turns one-shot off.

values.text: Counter reloads on overflow/underflow and keeps running.
Counter stops at the next underflow/overflow.

fields.name: LUPD
fields.text: While set, a hardware UPDATE does not load the registers from their buffers, so all buffers can be filled first and then released. No effect while input capture is on. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1 allows updates again.

values.text: On a hardware update, CCBx, PERB, PGVB, PGOB and SWAPBx are loaded into CCx, PER, PGV, PGO and SWAPx.
On a hardware update, CCBx, PERB, PGVB, PGOB and SWAPBx are not loaded into CCx, PER, PGV, PGO and SWAPx.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Counting direction. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1 clears the bit so the counter counts up.

registers.name: CTRLBSET

notes: Sets CTRLB bits without a read-modify-write; the change also shows in CTRLBCLR.

fields.name: CMD

fields.name: IDXCMD

values.name: DISABLE

values.name: SET
values.text: Set IDX: next cycle is cycle B.

values.name: CLEAR
values.text: Clear IDX: next cycle is cycle A.

values.name: HOLD
values.text: Hold IDX: next cycle repeats the current one.

fields.text: One-shot mode, in which the TCC stops at the next overflow/underflow or stop command. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1 turns one-shot on.

fields.text: While set, a hardware UPDATE does not load the registers from their buffers, so all buffers can be filled first and then released. No effect while input capture is on. Writing 0 does nothing; writing 1 locks updates.

fields.name: PER

fields.name: FILTERVAL
fields.text: Filter applied to the MCEx (x=0,1) event input; must be 0 when MCEx is used as a synchronous event.

fields.name: BLANKVAL
fields.text: Blanking length: after the waveform edge chosen by FCTRLn.BLANK, the fault input is ignored for a count of BLANKVAL periods of the prescaled GCLK_TCC.

fields.name: BLANKPRESC
fields.text: Multiplies the BLANKVAL time base by 64.

values.text: Blanking lasts BLANKVAL prescaled GCLK_TCC periods.
Blanking lasts BLANKVAL x 64 prescaled GCLK_TCC periods.

fields.name: CAPTURE
fields.text: Chooses whether and when a valid recoverable Fault n captures the counter, and when the Fault n interrupt and event are raised.

values.name: DISABLE
values.text: No capture on a valid recoverable Fault n.

values.name: CAPT
values.text: Each rising edge of a valid Fault n captures the counter into the CHSEL channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on every new capture.

values.name: CAPTMIN
values.text: A rising edge of a valid Fault n captures the counter into the CHSEL channel when COUNT is below the last stored CC value; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local minimum.

values.name: CAPTMAX
values.text: A rising edge of a valid Fault n captures the counter into the CHSEL channel when COUNT is above the last stored CC value; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local maximum.

values.name: LOCMIN
values.text: Each rising edge of a valid Fault n captures the counter into the CHSEL channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local minimum.

values.name: LOCMAX
values.text: Each rising edge of a valid Fault n captures the counter into the CHSEL channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local maximum.

values.name: DERIV0
values.text: Each rising edge of a valid Fault n captures the counter into the CHSEL channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local maximum or minimum.

fields.name: CHSEL
fields.text: Channel that a capture from recoverable Fault n is written to.

fields.name: HALT
fields.text: Halt action taken on recoverable Fault n.

fields.name: RESTART
fields.text: Turns on the restart action for Fault n.

fields.name: BLANK
fields.text: Where blanking of recoverable Fault n begins.

values.name: RISE
values.text: Rising edge of the waveform output.

values.name: FALL
values.text: Falling edge of the waveform output.

values.name: BOTH
values.text: Every toggle of the waveform output.

fields.name: QUAL
fields.text: Turns on qualification of the recoverable Fault n input.

values.text: Fault n input stays active whatever CMPx is.
Fault n input is ignored while the output is inactive (CMPx = 0).

fields.name: KEEP
fields.text: Turns on the keep action for Fault n.

values.text: Fault n state ends as soon as the fault goes away.
Fault n state ends at the end of the TCC cycle.

fields.name: SRC
fields.text: Event input that feeds recoverable Fault n; the event channel driving MCEx must be set to asynchronous routing for this use.

values.name: ALTFAULT
values.text: State of the alternate fault (A or B) when the previous period ended.

fields.name: DTHS
fields.text: Dead time on the high-side outputs, in GCLK_TCC cycles.

fields.name: DTLS
fields.text: Dead time on the low-side outputs, in GCLK_TCC cycles.

fields.name: DTIENx
fields.text: Turns on the dead-time generator for output matrix x, which drives outputs [x] and [x+WO_NUM/2] with the low-side and high-side waveforms.

values.text: Dead time inserted on outputs [x] and [x+WO_NUM/2], taken from matrix output [x].

fields.name: OTMX
fields.text: Routing of the TCC waveform outputs to the port pins (output matrix).

fields.name: FILTERVAL1
fields.text: Filter applied to the TCE1 event input; must be 0x0 when TCE1 is a synchronous event.

fields.name: FILTERVAL0
fields.text: Filter applied to the TCE0 event input; must be 0x0 when TCE0 is a synchronous event.

fields.name: INVENx
fields.text: A 1 in bit x inverts output WO[x]; a 0 leaves it uninverted.

fields.name: NRVx
fields.text: Level driven on each overridden output while a non-recoverable fault is active.

fields.name: NREx
fields.text: Per-output enable of the NRVx override during a non-recoverable fault.

values.text: Output goes tri-state on a non-recoverable fault.
Output is driven to its NRVx level on a non-recoverable fault.

fields.name: FDDBD
fields.text: Whether an OCD break request raises a non-recoverable fault. At 0 (default) OCD fault protection is on and a break triggers the fault; at 1 it is off. Software reset leaves it unchanged; do not change it while the TCC is enabled.

values.text: No fault when the TCC is halted in debug mode.
Halting the TCC in debug mode raises a non-recoverable fault and sets FAULTD.

fields.name: DBGRUN
fields.text: Whether the TCC keeps running while the CPU is halted by the debugger. Software reset leaves it unchanged; do not change it while the TCC is enabled.

values.text: Stops while the debugger halts the device.
Keeps running while the debugger halts the device.

fields.name: MCEOx
fields.text: Enables the event output for a match or capture on channel x.

values.text: Event on every compare or capture of channel x.

fields.name: MCEIx
fields.text: Enables the match or capture input event to channel CCx.

fields.name: TCEIx
fields.text: Enables input event x into the TCC.

fields.name: TCINVx
fields.text: Inverts input event x.

fields.name: CNTEO
fields.text: Enables the counter cycle event, made at the start or end of a counter cycle as CNTSEL sets.

values.text: Counter cycle event made as CNTSEL sets.

fields.name: TRGEO
fields.text: Enables an event each time the counter re-triggers.

fields.name: OVFEO
fields.text: Enables an event when the counter reaches TOP or ZERO.

fields.name: CNTSEL
fields.text: Point in the counter cycle at which the counter interrupt/event is made.

values.name: BOUNDARY
values.text: Start of the first cycle and end of the last cycle.

fields.name: EVACT1
fields.text: Action taken on the TCE1 event input.

values.name: RETRIGGER
values.text: Start, restart or re-trigger the counter.

values.name: PPW
values.text: Period into CC0, pulse width into CC1.

values.name: PWP
values.text: Period into CC1, pulse width into CC0.

fields.name: EVACT0

values.name: RETRIGGER
values.text: Start, restart or re-trigger the counter.

fields.name: MCx
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after a compare match, or once CCx holds a valid capture. Writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing; in capture mode, reading CCx clears it too.

fields.name: FAULT1
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after non-recoverable Fault 1 occurs; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULT0
fields.text: Non-recoverable Fault 0 flag; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTB
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after recoverable Fault B occurs; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTA
fields.text: Recoverable Fault A flag, set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after the fault occurs; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DFS
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after a debug fault state occurs; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UFS
fields.text: Set when the ramp index changes while CTRLBSET.LUPD is set; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Set when a channel captures again while its MCx flag is still 1, so the new capture has no place to go; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CNT
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after each counter event; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TRG
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after the counter re-triggers; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after an overflow; writing 1 clears it, writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CMPx
fields.text: Current compare output level of channel x.

fields.name: CCBUFVx
fields.text: Compare channel: set when CCBUFx is written, cleared by writing 1 while CTRLB.LUPD is set or on an UPDATE. Capture channel: set when CCBUFx holds a valid capture, cleared when CCx is read.

fields.name: FAULTx
fields.text: Set by hardware when non-recoverable Fault x occurs; cleared by writing 1 while the matching FAULTxIN is low. The counter then resumes from its last COUNT; to resume from BOTTOM, issue the restart command (CTRLBSET.CMD) before clearing it.

fields.name: FAULTB
fields.text: Set by hardware when recoverable Fault B occurs; cleared by hardware when the Fault B action resumes, or by writing 1 while FAULTBIN is low. With software halt (FAULTB.HALT=SW), clearing it releases the counter.

fields.name: FAULTA
fields.text: Set by hardware when recoverable Fault A occurs; cleared by hardware when the Fault A action resumes, or by writing 1 while FAULTAIN is low. With software halt (FAULTA.HALT=SW), clearing it releases the counter.

fields.name: FAULT1IN
fields.text: Reads 1 while non-recoverable Fault 1 input is active.

fields.name: FAULT0IN
fields.text: Reads 1 while non-recoverable Fault 0 input is active.

fields.name: FAULTBIN
fields.text: Reads 1 while recoverable Fault B input is active.

fields.name: FAULTAIN
fields.text: Reads 1 while recoverable Fault A input is active.

fields.name: PERBUFV
fields.text: Set when PERBUF is written; cleared by hardware on an UPDATE while CTRLB.LUPD is set, or by writing 1.

fields.name: PATTBUFV
fields.text: Set when PATTBUF is written; cleared by hardware on an UPDATE while CTRLB.LUPD is set, or by writing 1.

fields.name: DFS
fields.text: Set by hardware in debug mode when DBGCTRL.FDDBD is 1; cleared by writing 1 once the TCC is out of debug mode. While set, the counter is halted and the outputs follow DRVCTRL.NRE and DRVCTRL.NRV.

fields.name: UFS
fields.text: Hardware sets it if the ramp index changes while CTRLBSET.LUPD is set; writing 1 clears it. While set, the outputs follow DRVCTRL.NRE and DRVCTRL.NRV.

fields.name: IDX
fields.text: In RAMP2 and RAMP2A, 0 during cycle A and 1 during cycle B; always 0 in RAMP1.

fields.name: STOP
fields.text: Set when the TCC stops, either by a STOP command or by an UPDATE in one-shot mode (CTRLBSET.ONESHOT=1); cleared at the next counter increment or decrement.

registers.name: COUNT
registers.title: Counter Value
notes: Before every read, synchronize the register by writing CTRLBSET.CMD = READSYNC.

fields.name: COUNT
fields.text: Counter value. Unused upper bits read 0 in 24- or 16-bit mode. The field spans [31:m], with m set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE 31:0, DITH4 31:4, DITH5 31:5, DITH6 31:6.

fields.name: PGV
fields.text: Pattern level for each waveform output.

fields.name: PGE
fields.text: Per-output pattern enable; a 1 replaces that SWAP output with its PGVn level.

fields.name: SWAP
fields.text: Swaps DTI outputs [x] and [x+WO_NUM/2]; the DTIxEN settings do not affect it.

fields.name: POL
fields.text: Output polarity of channel x in single-slope and dual-slope PWM.

values.text: Output starts at ~DIR and goes to DIR on a match with CCx.
Output starts at DIR and goes to ~DIR on a match with CCx.
Output goes to ~DIR on a match with CCx.
Output goes to DIR on a match with CCx.

fields.name: CICCEN
fields.text: Turns on the circular compare buffer for channel x: on UPDATE, the CCx value is copied back into CCx.

fields.name: CIPEREN
fields.text: Turns on the circular period buffer: on UPDATE, PER is copied back into PERB.

fields.name: RAMP
fields.text: Ramp operation.

fields.name: WAVEGEN
fields.text: Waveform generation mode: sets the top value and picks frequency or PWM generation.

values.name: NFRQ
values.text: Normal frequency: TOP is PER, update at TOP or zero, output toggles on match and holds on update, OVF at TOP up and zero down.

values.name: MFRQ
values.text: Match frequency: TOP is CC0, update at TOP or zero, output toggles on match and holds on update, OVF at TOP up and zero down.

values.name: NPWM
values.text: Normal PWM: TOP is PER, update at TOP or zero, output set on match and cleared on update, OVF at TOP up and zero down.

values.name: DSCRITICAL
values.text: Dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at zero, output to ~DIR on match and holds on update, OVF at zero only.

values.name: DSBOTTOM
values.text: Dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at zero, output to ~DIR on match and holds on update, OVF at zero only.

values.name: DSBOTH
values.text: Dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at TOP and zero, output to ~DIR on match and holds on update, OVF at TOP and zero.

values.name: DSTOP
values.text: Dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at zero, output to ~DIR on match and holds on update, OVF at TOP only.

fields.name: PER
fields.text: Period value. Unused upper bits read 0 in 16- or 24-bit mode. The field spans [31:m], with m set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE 31:0, DITH4 31:4, DITH5 31:5, DITH6 31:6.

fields.name: DITHER
fields.text: Extra cycles added to the PWM period over every 64 PWM frames. Width set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE none, DITH4 3:0, DITH5 4:0, DITH6 5:0.

registers.name: CCx
registers.title: Compare/Capture Channel x
notes: Holds a 16-, 24- or 32-bit value. For capture it is the second buffer stage and the point where the CPU and DMA read it; for compare it is checked against the counter all the time, and the comparator output normally makes the waveform. CCx is loaded from CCBUFx on an UPDATE. In match frequency operation CC0 sets the counter period.

fields.name: CC
fields.text: Compare/capture value of channel x. Unused upper bits read 0 in 16-bit mode. The field spans [23:m], with m set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE 23:0, DITH4 23:4, DITH5 23:5, DITH6 23:6.

fields.name: DITHER
fields.text: Extra cycles added to the PWM pulse width over every 64 PWM frames. Width set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE none, DITH4 3:0, DITH5 4:0, DITH6 5:0.

fields.name: PGVB
fields.text: Buffer for PGV; with double buffering, a valid value moves into PGV on UPDATE.

fields.name: PGEB
fields.text: Buffer for PGE; with double buffering, a valid value moves into PGE on UPDATE.

fields.name: SWAPB
fields.text: Buffer for the SWAP bits; with double buffering, valid bits move into SWAPx on UPDATE.

fields.name: CICCENB
fields.text: Buffer for the CICCENx bits; with double buffering, valid bits move into CICCENx on UPDATE.

fields.name: CIPERENB
fields.text: Buffer for CIPEREN; with double buffering, a valid bit moves into CIPEREN on UPDATE.

fields.name: RAMPB
fields.text: Buffer for RAMP; with double buffering, valid bits move into RAMP on UPDATE.

fields.name: WAVEGENB
fields.text: Buffer for WAVEGEN; with double buffering, valid bits move into WAVEGEN on UPDATE.

fields.name: PERBUF
fields.text: Period buffer value, moved into PER on UPDATE. Unused upper bits read 0 in 16- or 24-bit mode. The field spans [31:m], with m set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE 31:0, DITH4 31:4, DITH5 31:5, DITH6 31:6.

fields.name: DITHERBUF
fields.text: Buffer for PER.DITHER; with double buffering, it moves into PER.DITHER on UPDATE. Width set by CTRLA.RESOLUTION: NONE none, DITH4 3:0, DITH5 4:0, DITH6 5:0.

registers.name: CCBUFn
registers.title: Channel n Compare/Capture Buffer Value

fields.name: HASHKEY

fields.text: Set when a RAM access error happens during an OUT stage; requests an interrupt if INTENSET.RAMACER is 1. Cleared by writing 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UPRSM
fields.text: Set when an Upstream Resume signal arrives from the device; requests an interrupt if INTENSET.UPRSM is 1. Cleared by writing 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DNRSM
fields.text: Set when the host has sent a Down Resume; requests an interrupt if INTENSET.DNRSM is 1. Cleared by writing 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: WAKEUP
fields.text: Set when, in suspend (SOFE 0), an upstream resume or a device disconnect is seen, or when, operational (VBUSOK 1), a device connect is seen. Requests an interrupt if INTENSET.WAKEUP is 1. Cleared by writing 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RST
fields.text: Goes to 1 once the host has driven a bus reset to the device; requests an interrupt if INTENSET.RST is 1. Cleared by writing 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: HSOF
fields.text: Set each 1 ms when a Host Start-of-Frame (full speed) or keep-alive (low speed) goes out, and FNUM is updated; requests an interrupt if INTENSET.HSOF is 1. Cleared by writing 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: PINT
fields.text: Bit n is 1 while pipe n has an interrupt pending (PINTFLAG) and goes to 0 when none is left. Writes do nothing.

fields.name: PTYPE

fields.name: PTOKEN
fields.text: Token the pipe sends: 0x0 SETUP (control pipes only), 0x1 IN, 0x2 OUT, 0x3 reserved. Ignored when PTYPE is extended. Cleared when a USB reset is sent.

fields.name: BINTERVAL
fields.text: Ping / bulk-out period. At 0, OUT tokens repeat within one frame until the peripheral acks; above 0, one OUT token goes out every BINTERVAL frames until acked. fields.text: With this set, the ADC runs only while a peripheral asks for it and is off otherwise; with it clear, an enabled ADC runs all the time. In standby the on-demand behaviour holds only if CTRLA.RUNSTDBY is 1, otherwise the ADC is off. Not synchronized.

values.text: ADC runs only while a peripheral requests a conversion; off when none does.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Run in standby: sets whether the ADC keeps working in standby sleep mode. Not synchronized.

values.text: ADC keeps going in standby: with CTRLA.ONDEMAND=1 it runs when a peripheral requests it; with CTRLA.ONDEMAND=0 it runs all the time.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the ADC on or off. The new value reads back at once and SYNCBUSY.ENABLE goes to 1; the change takes effect after synchronization, when SYNCBUSY.ENABLE returns to 0.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Software reset: a 1 returns every ADC register except DBGCTRL to its reset value and disables the ADC; a 0 does nothing. A 1 here overrides any other bits written in the same access. The reset finishes after synchronization, when CTRLA.SWRST and SYNCBUSY.SWRST both go back to 0.

fields.name: PRESCALER
fields.text: Divides the peripheral clock to make the ADC clock. Not synchronized.

fields.name: REFCOMP
fields.text: Turns on offset compensation in the reference buffer, which lowers gain error; it also lowers the input impedance and so lengthens the reference start-up time.

fields.name: REFSEL
fields.text: Picks the voltage the ADC converts against.

values.name: INTVCC1
values.text: Half of VDDANA; only for VDDANA above 2.0 V.

fields.name: WINMONEO
fields.text: Window monitor event out: when set, the ADC emits an event each time the window monitor detects its condition.

fields.name: RESRDYEO
fields.text: Result ready event out: when set, the ADC emits an event each time a conversion result becomes available.

fields.name: STARTINV

fields.name: FLUSHINV
fields.text: Flush event invert enable: inverts the incoming flush event.

fields.name: FLUSHEI

values.text: Any incoming event flushes and starts a new conversion.

fields.name: OVERRUN

fields.name: WINMON
fields.text: Goes to 1 one GCLK_ADC cycle after the window monitor condition matches, and raises an interrupt if INTENCLR/SET.WINMON is 1. A read of RESULT clears it, as does a write of 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVERRUN
fields.text: Goes to 1 when a new value lands in RESULT before the CPU has read the last one, and raises an interrupt if INTENCLR/SET.OVERRUN is 1. Cleared by writing 1 to it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RESRDY
fields.text: Goes to 1 when a conversion result is ready, and raises an interrupt if INTENCLR/SET.RESRDY is 1. A read of RESULT clears it, as does a write of 1; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: SEQBUSY
fields.text: Sequence busy: 1 from the start of a sequence until its last conversion finishes.

fields.name: SEQSTATE
fields.text: Sequence pointer: gives which conversion in the sequence finished most recently.

fields.name: MUXNEG
fields.text: Chooses what drives the ADC negative input.

fields.name: MUXPOS
fields.text: Chooses what drives the ADC positive input. When the bandgap or the temperature sensor is chosen, SAMPCTRL.SAMPLEN has to be set to a matching value.

fields.name: WINMODE
fields.text: Turns on the window monitor and chooses which comparison of RESULT against WINLT and WINUT it watches for.

values.name: DISABLE
values.text: Window monitor off; the reset setting.

fields.name: RESSEL
fields.text: Chooses the resolution of the conversion result: 12, 10 or 8 bits, or the output of averaging mode.

fields.name: CORREN
fields.text: Digital correction logic enable: applies gain and offset correction to the result.

values.text: RESULT is corrected for gain and offset using GAINCORR and OFFSETCORR; each conversion takes 13 cycles longer, depending on OFFSETCORR.OFFSETCORR.

fields.name: FREERUN
fields.text: Free running mode: chooses single conversions or back-to-back conversions.

values.text: Free running: each finished conversion starts the next.

fields.name: LEFTADJ
fields.text: Left-adjusted result: chooses how the result is aligned in RESULT.

values.text: Result right-aligned in RESULT; the reset setting.
Result left-aligned in RESULT, so the high byte of a 12-bit result sits in the register's upper part.

fields.name: DIFFMODE
fields.text: Differential mode: chooses single-ended or differential conversion.

values.text: Differential: the ADC converts the voltage between the MUXPOS and MUXNEG inputs.

fields.name: ADJRES
fields.text: Adjusting result: the division coefficient applied to the accumulated result, in powers of 2.

fields.name: SAMPLENUM
fields.text: Number of samples summed into one result, which then appears in RESULT. When the result grows wider, CTRLC.RESSEL has to be changed to match.

fields.name: OFFCOMP
fields.text: Comparator offset compensation enable: runs offset compensation in every sampling period for low offset and immunity to temperature and voltage drift, at the cost of three extra clock cycles of sampling. SAMPLEN takes effect only with this bit at 0; OFFCOMP=1 cannot be combined with SAMPLEN above 0.

fields.name: SAMPLEN
fields.text: Sampling time in ADC clock periods, which sets the ADC input impedance: TS = (SAMPLEN+1) x CLK_ADC, with CLK_ADC depending on the prescaler. Works only while OFFCOMP is 0.

fields.name: WINLT
fields.text: Lower threshold used by the window monitor when it is on.

fields.name: WINUT
fields.text: Upper threshold used by the window monitor when it is on.

fields.name: GAINCORR
fields.text: Gain correction applied to each result before it is stored, when CTRLC.CORREN is 1. A fixed-point number with 1 integer bit and 11 fraction bits, from 0.10000000000 to 1.11111111111 in binary, so 1/2 <= GAINCORR < 2.

fields.name: OFFSETCORR
fields.text: Offset correction applied to each result before it is stored, when CTRLC.CORREN is 1; a two's complement number.

fields.name: START
fields.text: Writing 1 begins a conversion or a sequence; hardware clears the bit once the conversion is under way. Writing 1 while it is still set, or writing 0, does nothing.

fields.name: FLUSH
fields.text: Writing 1 flushes the ADC pipeline: the ADC clock restarts on the next peripheral clock edge and any conversions in progress are dropped. The bit stays set until the flush is done, after which the ADC picks up where it was, starting a new conversion if one was pending. Writing 0 does nothing.

fields.text: Debug run: sets whether the ADC keeps running while an external debugger halts the CPU. A software reset leaves it unchanged; write it only when no conversion is in progress.

fields.text: The conversion result, up to 16 bits depending on configuration. A single conversion without averaging gives 12 bits. fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the DAC controller on or off. The written value reads back at once while SYNCBUSY.ENABLE is set; the change takes effect after synchronization, when SYNCBUSY.ENABLE clears.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 returns every DAC register to its reset value and disables the DAC; writing 0 does nothing. A reset write overrides any other write in the same access. CTRLA.SWRST and SYNCBUSY.SWRST both clear once the reset, delayed by synchronization, has finished.
